title: CPU consumed while the cold OIDC load is in flight
question: Is the stall a process that is blocked and idle, or a process that is saturated? Latency alone cannot tell them apart.

config.workload: the S4 workload, sampled concurrently rather than in a separate pass
config.sampled_how: cpu.stat differenced between consecutive samples read from the host cgroup filesystem bind-mounted read only into the bench container

verdicts.legacy_shape: upstream armasec: 0.050 cores during the stall against a 0.082 core baseline (below baseline) while /health p99 was 1067ms
verdicts.lite_shape: armasec-lite: 0.077 cores during the stall against a 0.114 core baseline (below baseline) while /health p99 was 6ms
